name: Mondi plc
source: CRON 2026-10-14: H1 2026 column added from Mondi plc Half Year Results Announcement 2026, condensed consolidated income statement page 12 and financial summary page 2, six months ended 30 June 2026, from mondigroup.com. EUR million stored as absolute euro: Group revenue 3,975; materials, energy and consumables used 2,070; variable selling expenses 388; gross margin 1,517; maintenance and other indirect expenses 184; personnel costs 722; other net operating expenses 256; EBITDA 355; depreciation, amortisation and impairments 533; operating loss 178; net loss from joint ventures 1; net finance costs 58; investment income 9; foreign currency gains 1; finance costs 68; net monetary loss from hyperinflationary economies 3; loss before tax 240; tax charge 3; loss for the period 243; loss attributable to shareholders 255 with 12 of profit attributable to non-controlling interests. Basic loss per share 57.8 euro cents. Mapping: Cost of Sales is materials, energy and consumables used plus variable selling expenses, which reproduces the printed gross margin of 1,517 as gross profit; Operating Expenses is maintenance and other indirect expenses plus personnel costs plus other net operating expenses, and gross profit less that equals the printed operating loss of 178. Net Profit follows the file own convention of the attributable figure (255): loss before tax less the 3 tax charge is 243, the remaining 12 being non-controlling interests. CRON 20261124: FY2021 column from Mondi plc Full Year Results Announcement for the year ended 31 December 2021, condensed consolidated income statement derived from the audited group annual financial statements audited by PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP, EUR million stored as absolute euro. Printed total column: group revenue 7,723; materials, energy and consumables used 3,777; variable selling expenses 639; gross margin 3,307; maintenance and other indirect expenses 391; personnel costs 1,102; other net operating expenses 308; operating profit 1,071; net finance costs 98; profit before tax 983; tax charge 210; profit for the year 773 with 17 to non-controlling interests and 756 to shareholders; basic EPS 155.9 euro cents. Same mapping as the H1 2026 column in this file: Cost of Sales is materials, energy and consumables used plus variable selling expenses (7,723 less 4,416 equals the printed gross margin 3,307), Operating Expenses is maintenance plus personnel plus other net operating expenses. Net Profit is the attributable figure as elsewhere in this row, so profit before tax less tax gives 773 before the 17 non-controlling interests. Two cells replaced: the stored Gross Profit 2,764 and EPS 1.7138 were a secondary feed stub, and 2,764 with the printed 3,307 gross margin and the printed 155.9 cent basic EPS of the audited statement supersede them. ROE, ROA and Debt to Equity are left empty because this file holds no FY2021 balance sheet.
